{
  "process": "Each row represents a single telemarketing contact attempt. The process begins with the client's pre‑existing record (demographics, history, etc.), then a contact method and timing are chosen, the call is placed and its duration measured, and finally after the call ends we observe whether the client subscribed to the product.",
  "target_known_at": "after the call ends, when the subscription outcome is observed",
  "prediction_point": "just before the call is placed, when all pre‑call client and campaign information is known but the call duration and subscription outcome are not yet known",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "prior_contact_count", "event": "prior contact count known from historical logs before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "client_age", "event": "client demographic known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98},
    {"name": "comm_method", "event": "contact method chosen before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96},
    {"name": "call_length_sec", "event": "call duration measured during the call", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "day_of_month", "event": "date of the call known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "schooling", "event": "client education known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98},
    {"name": "charged_off", "event": "client credit status known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96},
    {"name": "civil_status", "event": "client marital status known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "consumer_credit_flag", "event": "client credit flag known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96},
    {"name": "prior_campaign_result", "event": "outcome of previous campaign known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "avg_yearly_bal", "event": "average yearly balance known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.98},
    {"name": "home_loan_flag", "event": "home loan flag known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96},
    {"name": "occupation", "event": "client occupation known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "contacts_this_run", "event": "number of contacts made so far in this campaign run before the current call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.95},
    {"name": "contact_mth", "event": "month of the call known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.97},
    {"name": "days_since_prev_contact", "event": "days since previous contact known before the call", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.96}
  ]
}
